ValidationRule.description: Do not allow user to update the Status to In Progress if today is not within the start and end date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( ISCHANGED( Status ) || ISCHANGED (StartDate)|| ISCHANGED (EndDate))&& ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Progress') && (NOT(TODAY() >= StartDate) || NOT(TODAY() <= EndDate)) && Record_Type_Name__c == 'Tactic Campaign'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to update the Campaign Status to “In Progress” as today is not within the Campaign Start and End Date
